title: Detectors for Safe and Reliable LLMs: Implementations, Uses, and Limitations
benchmark_measurement: Stereotype and stigma detection in a religious context (specifically, Islam).
findings: The paper uses a prompt involving a Muslim job applicant as an example to demonstrate how targeted prompts can be used to elicit potentially stigmatizing content from LLMs for the purpose of evaluating and improving safety detectors. No specific findings on the level of religious bias in any particular model were reported.
